obfuscation_indicators: no assurance that expectations will be achieved
risk_summary: The disclosure provides useful quantitative detail on occupancy, lease expirations, rent receivables, and covenant compliance, but relies heavily on standard forward-looking disclaimers and conditional language. Key risks include tenant defaults, declining occupancy and rents, higher financing costs, development overruns, and continued COVID-19 and inflation effects. Overall tone is cautious and materially risk-aware, with some offsetting confidence in asset quality and balance-sheet access to capital.
